features: Big sound in the palm of your hand: JBL Go 5 delivers louder JBL Pro Sound with deeper bass from an ultra-compact speaker that fits in your palm.
Mood-boosting ambient edge LIGHTING: Ambient edge LIGHTING enhances the listening experience with visual indicators for power, pairing, low battery, and Auracast mode.
AirTouch instant stereo pairing: Instantly pair two JBL Go 5 speakers for true stereo sound with dedicated left and right channels.
Up to 10 hours with Playtime Boost: Enjoy up to 8 hours of playback, plus an additional 2 hours using Playtime Boost for extended listening.
Pure sound with lossless playback: Supports lossless USB-C audio for high-quality music streaming with enhanced detail and clarity.
All the proofs (dust, water, and drop): IP68-rated waterproof and dustproof protection, combined with a durable drop-proof design, ensures reliability in various environments.
Link up and play with Auracast: Connect multiple Auracast enabled JBL speakers wirelessly for a wider and more immersive audio experience.
Customize with the JBL Portable app: Personalize sound with a 7-band EQ and lighting themes through the JBL Portable app.
